title: GeoLEON-CLIP: Graph-Anchored Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Geographic Region Representation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32311v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Geographic regions are multimodal: satellite imagery captures visual morphology, text conveys human-interpretable semantics, and map structures describe urban context. Existing geospatial contrastive methods typically align image-text or image-location pairs, underusing structured map data. We introduce GeoLEON-CLIP, a graph-anchored contrastive framework that aligns three views of each H3-indexed region: an OpenStreetMap-derived graph embedding, a satellite image crop, and a textual description. Frozen pretrained LEON graph embeddings provide a semantic anchor between vision and language. Frozen graph, image, and text encoders are connected by trainable residual projection heads and trained with a symmetric tri-modal contrastive objective. translated_title: GeoLEON-CLIP：面向地理区域表征的图锚定多模态对比学习
translated_abstract: 地理区域本质上是多模态的：卫星影像捕捉视觉形态，文本传达人类可理解的语义，地图结构则描述城市环境。现有的地理空间对比学习方法通常只对齐图像-文本或图像-位置对，未能充分利用结构化地图数据。我们提出GeoLEON-CLIP，这是一个图锚定的对比学习框架，对齐每个以H3索引的区域的三个视图：源自OpenStreetMap的图嵌入、卫星图像裁剪区域以及文本描述。冻结的预训练LEON图嵌入在视觉与语言之间提供语义锚点。冻结的图、图像和文本编码器通过可训练的残差投影头相连接，并以对称的三模态对比目标进行训练。实验表明，该模型实现了强大的图-图像和图-文本对齐效果；在混合分辨率池中，图-图像检索取得了最佳的跨模态性能。为了评估锚定假设，我们...
tldr: 该论文提出GeoLEON-CLIP框架，以冻结的预训练LEON图嵌入作为语义锚点，通过三模态对比学习将OpenStreetMap图结构、卫星影像和文本描述对齐，从而充分利用结构化地图数据并实现最优的跨模态地理区域表征与检索性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces GeoLEON-CLIP, a graph-anchored tri-modal contrastive framework that leverages frozen pretrained LEON graph embeddings as semantic anchors to align OpenStreetMap graph structures, satellite imagery, and text descriptions, enabling superior cross-modal geographic region representation and retrieval performance.
